messages:
anna: Quick postmortem follow-up from the p95-latency incident (yesterday). Need owners for remediation & SLO updates. TL;DR: recurring spikes ~02:00 UTC, cache miss pattern. Proposed SLO tweaks: keep p50 50ms, tighten p95 300ms -> 220ms, leave p99 at 1s. Also set error-budget burn alert to trigger earlier. Actions to claim: (A) SLO config + infra migration, (B) dashboard + alert tuning, (C) runbook update for recurring spike playbook, (D) routing/fallback policy. Please claim by EOD today.

mike: I’ll take (A) — will open a PR with the SLO change + migration steps. Target: PR by Thu EOD. Quick Q: should we also tighten p99?

anna: Keep p99 at 1s for now. We want to maintain a cushion for tail events while we test p95 tightening.

priya: I’ll own (B) and (C). Plan: dashboard p95 heatmap by region + hourly anomaly rule. Add alert `error_budget_burn > 1.5 for 30m` -> page oncall-sre. Runbook: add checklist for cache eviction stats and quick rollback commands.

priya: Alert rule (promql):

sum(rate(error_budget_burn[5m])) by (team) > 1.5

priya: Will stage dashboards + runbook changes in staging and post links here when ready.

dave: I’ll take (D). Plan: implement canary fallback to a lighter-quant model in same pool when sustained p95 > 250ms for 3m. Will add a metric for fallback triggers so we can monitor impact.

anna: Great. Priya/dave please coordinate on the fallback trigger widget so it's visible on the incident dashboard.

mike: Ack. I’ll also add a migration note so Dedicated customers get a heads-up about SLO change semantics.

oncall-bot: Deploybot: canary-policy-config pushed to staging at 2190012600 (staging-deploy-42).

priya: :thumbsup: Aiming to have dashboard + alert in staging by Wed.

a nna: Assigning owners in the action tracker:
- mike: SLO PR + migration notes — due 2026-03-28
- priya: dashboards, alert rules, runbook edits — due 2026-03-25
- dave: routing & fallback policy + fallback metric — due 2026-03-26
We'll review progress in next SLO sync and run an infra smoke test after each change. Thanks everyone.

mike: Noted. If anyone needs more time or infra help ping me.

priya: Will post staging links when ready.

dave: Filing the RFC now and will link it here
